meta.title: Al Baraka | Fresh fruit & vegetables

meta.manifestDescription: Order fresh fruit and vegetables and pay cash on delivery.

install.title: Install the Al Baraka app
install.bannerText: Order faster from your phone's home screen.
install.afterOrderText: Install the app and follow your order from your home screen — no need to look for the link.
install.manualHint: From your browser's menu, choose “Add to Home Screen”

hero.titleLine2: from the market to your door
hero.subtitle: We hand-pick everything every morning. Order in a minute and get it the same day.

fresh.text: We buy from the market every morning

delivery.text: To your door the same day

fruits.title: Seasonal fruit
fruits.text: Sweet and fresh, picked one by one

vegetables.title: Everything for the kitchen

searchCta.text: Browse all products and filter by category and price until you find what you need.

products.description: Pick what you need and add it to your cart.

cart.fixItems: Update or remove the items marked in red to continue.
cart.emptyText: Add the fruit and vegetables you need, then come back here to place your order.

checkout.title: Checkout
checkout.intro: No account needed — leave your details and we'll call to confirm your order.
checkout.name: Name
checkout.phoneHint: We'll call you on it to confirm the order
checkout.areaHint: The delivery price depends on the area
checkout.addressPlaceholder: Street, building number, floor, apartment, and the nearest landmark

placed.title: We got your order
placed.text: We'll call you to confirm the order and the delivery time.
placed.keepNumber: Keep this number — you'll use it to track your order.

track.title: Track your order
track.description: Enter your order number to see where it is.
track.numberHint: It's the number shown on your order confirmation page

about.title: We shop for you like we shop for our own home
about.intro: Al Baraka is a group of fruit and vegetable shops that buy from the market every day. Our branches are close to you, so your order is packed and delivered within an hour, still fresh.
about.imageAlt: Shelves of fresh vegetables in the shop
about.stepsEyebrow: From the market to your door

pick.title: We pick by hand
pick.text: We go to the wholesale market as soon as it opens and choose every item ourselves. If we don't like it, we don't buy it.

weigh.title: We weigh after you order
weigh.text: Nothing is packed in advance. Your order is weighed and packed as soon as it reaches us.

pay.title: You pay when it arrives
pay.text: Check your order at the door and pay cash on delivery. No prepayment and no account needed.

about.guaranteeTitle: If you don't like an item, hand it back to the driver — you won't pay for it.
about.guaranteeText: It's simpler than any return policy, and it keeps us choosing well from the start.

deliveryAreas.title: Where we deliver
deliveryAreas.description: These are the areas we cover right now and the delivery price for each. If your area isn't listed, call us and we'll see how to reach you.

fast.title: Delivery within an hour
fast.text: From the moment we confirm your order by phone

byArea.title: Price depends on the area
byArea.text: Set when you choose your area at checkout

hours.title: All working hours
hours.text: Order any time the shop is open

deliveryAreas.empty: No delivery areas have been set yet
deliveryAreas.note: This is the delivery cost for the area; it's added to your order total when you choose it at checkout. Area not listed? Call us and we'll see how to reach you.

contact.title: Contact us
contact.areaCount: {count, plural, =0 {No areas yet} one {# area} other {# areas}}
contact.deliveryNote: The price depends on your area at checkout

footer.tagline: Fresh fruit and vegetables delivered within an hour.
footer.installText: An icon on your home screen, and a faster order next time.

notFound.title: This page isn't on the shelf
notFound.text: We looked in every aisle and couldn't find it. The link may be wrong or the item may be gone, but there's still plenty of fresh produce.

errorPage.title: Something went wrong on our side
errorPage.text: This page didn't load properly. Try again, and if it keeps happening, head back home.

auth.title: Dashboard login
auth.subtitle: This page is for the shop team only.

form.englishOptional: English is optional — if it's empty, the English site shows the Arabic.

admins.title: Admins
admins.description: Admins can manage orders, products and settings. Only the owner can add or remove admins.

admins.passwordHint: At least 8 characters — share it with the admin securely

settings.description: These details are shown to customers in the footer and contact sections.
